name: lever belt single leg romanian deadlift
description: A single-leg hip hinge on a belt-loaded lever machine that trains hamstrings and glutes with extra balance support.
instructions: Fasten the belt and stand on one leg on the platform with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as your torso lowers.
Let the free leg extend behind you for balance.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then switch legs after your reps.
